events.title: Steam Fest!
events.summary: Hi there! 👋If you've just found Mars Clicker through Steam Next Fest, welcome. A quick introduction: I'm Adrián, and I've been developing Mars Clicker solo. Professionally, I work at Secret Games Co as Lead Programmer, where we've been developing Bon Vivant. Feel free to check it out and add it to your wishlist 💫Mars Clicker is my personal project, the place where I have the creative freedom to grow in new directions. events.title: Mars Clicker — v0.8.0: Art Shift & More
events.summary: Hello explorers! 👋I've made a new version of the game after checking that the changes were stable. The biggest change is, of course, the art (which is not generated by AI). The main change is to the shaders to get that effect.As well as the artistic changes, I've also made lots of small improvements to the gameplay. events.title: Mars Clicker | Artistic shift
events.summary: Hi! I’d been thinking for a while about making a significant change to Mars Clicker, and with this latest update I think I’ve reached the point I really wanted to be at. The entire colour palette (AKA shaders) has been modified to achieve this Borderlands-style art effect; as a fan of the series, I couldn’t be happier with the result. events.title: Mars Clicker Demo is out!
events.summary: Hello everyone! 👋I’m thrilled to announce that the Mars Clicker demo is now live! 🎉🕹️ Download the free demo: At last, you can play a small section of the game. I’ve decided to limit the demo to a single prestige level, you’ll be able to play the rest of the game without restriction, but you won’t be able to progress beyond Tier 5. A few things to bear in mind regarding the demo: This is an early build, so a few bugs or glitches may crop up. Saved games will not carry over to the final release.

events.title: Development Blog: Event Horizon Devlog
events.summary: Hello explorers! This new adventure begins. I was really looking forward to update you on the development status of Mars Clicker. That's why I recently made a video for the youtube channel. Development has been delayed a bit by all the work it has taken to bring Space Battle to Nintendo Switch. Fortunately, everything is on track and we can only look forward.
